// 1. Fetch Live Matches List
export const fetchLiveMatches = async (category) => {
  /*
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/matches?status=${category}`, {
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${api_keys}` }
  });
  const data = await response.json();
  return mapApiToLocalModel(data);
  */
  return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(() => resolve(INITIAL_MOCK_DATA.filter(m => m.type === category)), 500));
};

    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${api_keys}` }
  });
  return response.json();

};

// 3. Fetch Ball-by-Ball Commentary
export const fetchCommentary = async (matchId, lastEventId) => {
  /*
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/matches/${matchId}/commentary?since=${lastEventId}`, {
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${api_keys}` }
  });
  return response.json();
  */
};

// Helper to simulate real-time cricket action dynamically
const simulateLiveAction = (match) => {
  if (match.type !== 'live') return match;

  const newMatch = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(match)); 
  const battingStats = newMatch[`${newMatch.battingTeam}Stats`];
  
  if (battingStats.wickets >= 10 || parseFloat(battingStats.overs) >= 20.0) {
    return newMatch; 
  }

  let [o, b] = battingStats.overs.split('.').map(Number);
  
  // Weights for realistic simulation
  const runOptions = [0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 2, 4, 6];
  const runsScored = runOptions[Math.floor(Math.random() * runOptions.length)];
  const isWicket = Math.random() < 0.08 && runsScored === 0;

  b++;
  if (b === 6) { o++; b = 0; }
  battingStats.overs = `${o}.${b}`;
  
  let eventStr = isWicket ? 'W' : runsScored.toString();
  let commText = '';

  if (isWicket) {
    battingStats.wickets++;
    newMatch.recentBalls.push('W');
    commText = `OUT! A massive breakthrough. The batsman has to walk back.`;
  } else {
    battingStats.score += runsScored;
    newMatch.recentBalls.push(runsScored.toString());
    
    if(runsScored === 4) commText = `FOUR! Beautifully struck through the gaps.`;
    else if(runsScored === 6) commText = `SIX! Out of the park! Magnificent hit.`;
    else if(runsScored === 0) commText = `Dot ball. Bowler keeping things tight.`;
    else commText = `${runsScored} run(s) taken down the ground.`;
    
    const striker = newMatch.batsmen.find(bat => bat.onStrike);
    if (striker) {
      striker.runs += runsScored;
      striker.balls += 1;
      if (runsScored === 4) striker.fours++;
      if (runsScored === 6) striker.sixes++;
      striker.strikeRate = ((striker.runs / striker.balls) * 100).toFixed(2);
      
      if (runsScored % 2 !== 0 || b === 0) {
        newMatch.batsmen.forEach(bat => bat.onStrike = !bat.onStrike);
      }
    }
  }

  if (newMatch.recentBalls.length > 8) newMatch.recentBalls.shift();

  // Add Commentary
  newMatch.commentary.unshift({
    id: `c_${Date.now()}`,
    over: battingStats.overs,
    event: eventStr,
    text: commText
  });
  if(newMatch.commentary.length > 20) newMatch.commentary.pop();

  const totalBalls = (o * 6) + b;
  if (totalBalls > 0) {
    newMatch.runRate = ((battingStats.score / totalBalls) * 6).toFixed(2);
  }

  return newMatch;
};

export default function CricketDashboard() {
  const [activeMainTab, setActiveMainTab] = useState('live');
  const [matches, setMatches] = useState(INITIAL_MOCK_DATA);
  const [seriesList] = useState(INITIAL_SERIES);
  const [selectedMatchId, setSelectedMatchId] = useState(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  // Load Data Effect
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeMainTab === 'series') return;
    setIsLoading(true);
    fetchLiveMatches(activeMainTab).then(data => {
      // If we fetch API data, we'd merge it. For this mock, we rely on local state to persist live simulation.
      // In production: setMatches(data);
      setIsLoading(false);
    });
  }, [activeMainTab]);

  // Live Auto-Update Interval
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeMainTab !== 'live') return;

    const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
      // Production: fetchLiveMatches('live').then(newData => updateState(newData));
      setMatches(prev => prev.map(m => simulateLiveAction(m)));
    }, 4500); // Simulate ball every 4.5 seconds

    return () => clearInterval(intervalId);
  }, [activeMainTab]);

  const displayedMatches = matches.filter(m => m.type === activeMainTab);
  const selectedMatch = matches.find(m => m.id === selectedMatchId);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-200 font-sans sm:pb-8">
      
      {/* Header */}
      <header className="bg-slate-900 border-b border-slate-800 sticky top-0 z-20 shadow-lg">
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 h-16 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-400">
            <Globe2 className="w-6 h-6" />
            <h1 className="text-xl font-black tracking-tight uppercase italic">
              Live<span className="text-white">Cricket</span> API-X
            </h1>
          </div>
          
          {activeMainTab === 'live' && (
            <div className="flex items-center text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 border border-red-500/20 uppercase tracking-widest">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-red-500 rounded-full mr-1.5 animate-pulse"></span>
              Live Updates
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Main Navigation */}
        {!selectedMatch && (
          <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 flex gap-6 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar border-t border-slate-800/50">
            {[
              { id: 'live', label: 'Live Matches', icon: <Activity className="w-4 h-4" /> },
              { id: 'recent', label: 'Completed', icon: <Clock className="w-4 h-4" /> },
              { id: 'upcoming', label: 'Upcoming', icon: <Calendar className="w-4 h-4" /> },
              { id: 'series', label: 'Series', icon: <Trophy className="w-4 h-4" /> },
            ].map(tab => (
               <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveMainTab(tab.id)}
                className={`flex items-center gap-2 py-4 px-1 border-b-2 font-semibold text-sm transition-colors whitespace-nowrap
                  ${activeMainTab === tab.id 
                    ? 'border-emerald-500 text-emerald-400' 
                    : 'border-transparent text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 hover:border-slate-700'
                  }`}
              >
                {tab.icon}
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </header>

      <main className="max-w-4xl mx-auto p-4 md:py-6">
        {isLoading && !selectedMatch ? (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {[1, 2].map(i => <div key={i} className="bg-slate-900 h-48 rounded-xl animate-pulse border border-slate-800"></div>)}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {selectedMatchId ? (
              <MatchDetails 
                match={selectedMatch} 
                onBack={() => setSelectedMatchId(null)} 
              />
            ) : activeMainTab === 'series' ? (
              <SeriesView series={seriesList} />
            ) : (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {displayedMatches.length > 0 ? (
                  displayedMatches.map(match => (
                    <MatchCard key={match.id} match={match} onClick={() => setSelectedMatchId(match.id)} />
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <div className="col-span-full py-16 text-center text-slate-500 bg-slate-900/50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 border-dashed">
                    <Swords className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-30" />
                    <p className="text-lg font-medium">No matches available.</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

function MatchCard({ match, onClick }) {
  const isLive = match.type === 'live';
  
  return (
    <div 
      onClick={onClick}
      className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 cursor-pointer hover:border-emerald-500/50 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-emerald-500/5 transition-all group flex flex-col justify-between"
    >
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
        <span className="text-xs font-bold tracking-wider text-slate-400 uppercase truncate pr-4">
          {match.series}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-4 mb-5">
        {[match.team1, match.team2].map((team, idx) => {
          const stats = match[`team${idx + 1}Stats`];
          const isBatting = match.battingTeam === `team${idx + 1}`;
          
          return (
            <div key={team.name} className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className={`w-3 h-8 rounded-sm ${team.color} opacity-80`}></div>
                <span className="font-bold text-lg text-slate-100">{team.name}</span>
              </div>
              {stats && (
                <div className="text-right flex items-baseline gap-2">
                  <span className={`font-black text-xl ${isBatting ? 'text-white' : 'text-slate-400'}`}>
                    {stats.score}/{stats.wickets}
                  </span>
                  {stats.overs !== '0.0' && (
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">({stats.overs})</span>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-auto pt-3 border-t border-slate-800/80">
        <p className={`text-sm font-medium line-clamp-1 ${isLive ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-slate-400'}`}>
          {match.status}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MatchDetails({ match, onBack }) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('scorecard');
  const isLive = match.type === 'live';

  return (
    <div className="animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-300">
      <button 
        onClick={onBack}
        className="flex items-center text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-300 mb-4 transition-colors"
      >
        <ChevronLeft className="w-5 h-5 mr-1" /> Dashboard
      </button>

      {/* Match Header Hero */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 md:p-6 shadow-xl mb-6">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-6">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xs font-black text-slate-400 tracking-widest uppercase">{match.series}</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1 font-medium">{match.venue}</p>
          </div>
          {isLive && (
            <div className="bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 text-[10px] font-black px-2 py-1 rounded uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-red-500 rounded-full mr-1.5 animate-ping"></span> LIVE
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-6">
          {/* Team 1 */}
          <div className="w-full md:w-2/5 flex flex-col md:items-start text-center md:text-left">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-2">{match.team1.fullName}</h3>
            {match.team1Stats && (
              <div>
                <span className="text-4xl font-black text-white">{match.team1Stats.score}<span className="text-2xl text-slate-500">/{match.team1Stats.wickets}</span></span>
                <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">Overs: <span className="text-slate-200">{match.team1Stats.overs}</span></p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="hidden md:flex w-1/5 justify-center">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black text-slate-500 border border-slate-700">VS</div>
          </div>

          {/* Team 2 */}
          <div className="w-full md:w-2/5 flex flex-col md:items-end text-center md:text-right">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-2">{match.team2.fullName}</h3>
            {match.team2Stats ? (
              <div>
                <span className="text-4xl font-black text-white">{match.team2Stats.score}<span className="text-2xl text-slate-500">/{match.team2Stats.wickets}</span></span>
                <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">Overs: <span className="text-slate-200">{match.team2Stats.overs}</span></p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-slate-600 font-medium italic">Yet to bat</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center text-sm">
          <p className="text-emerald-400 font-semibold">{match.status}</p>
          {match.runRate && (
            <p className="text-slate-400">CRR: <span className="text-white font-bold ml-1">{match.runRate}</span></p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Internal Tabs */}
      <div className="flex overflow-x-auto gap-2 mb-4 bg-slate-900 p-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
        {[
          { id: 'scorecard', icon: <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4" />, label: 'Scorecard' },
          { id: 'commentary', icon: <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />, label: 'Commentary' },
          { id: 'squads', icon: <Users className="w-4 h-4" />, label: 'Squads' },
          { id: 'info', icon: <Info className="w-4 h-4" />, label: 'Match Info' }
        ].map(tab => (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
            className={`flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2 px-3 rounded-md text-sm font-semibold transition-all whitespace-nowrap
              ${activeTab === tab.id ? 'bg-slate-800 text-emerald-400 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-800/50'}`}
          >
            {tab.icon} {tab.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Tab Content Render */}
      <div className="min-h-[400px]">
        {activeTab === 'scorecard' && <TabScorecard match={match} />}
        {activeTab === 'commentary' && <TabCommentary match={match} />}
        {activeTab === 'squads' && <TabSquads match={match} />}
        {activeTab === 'info' && (
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 text-slate-300">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white mb-4">Match Information</h3>
            <ul className="space-y-4">
              <li className="flex justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Series</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-right">{match.series}</span>
              </li>
              <li className="flex justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Venue</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-right">{match.venue}</span>
              </li>
              <li className="flex justify-between pb-2">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Toss / Status</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-right">{match.status}</span>
              </li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TabScorecard({ match }) {
  if (!match.batsmen || match.batsmen.length === 0) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">Scorecard not available yet.</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Batting */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg">
        <div className="bg-slate-800/50 px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-700">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-sm tracking-wide uppercase text-slate-200">Batting</h3>
        </div>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-sm text-left whitespace-nowrap">
            <thead className="text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-slate-800">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Batter</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">R</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">B</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right hidden sm:table-cell">4s</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right hidden sm:table-cell">6s</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">SR</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/50">
              {match.batsmen.map((b, i) => (
                <tr key={i} className="hover:bg-slate-800/30">
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 flex items-center font-semibold text-white">
                    {b.name}
                    {b.onStrike && <span className="ml-2 w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse"></span>}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 font-black text-white text-right">{b.runs}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 text-right">{b.balls}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 text-right hidden sm:table-cell">{b.fours}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 text-right hidden sm:table-cell">{b.sixes}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 text-right">{b.strikeRate}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bowling */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg">
        <div className="bg-slate-800/50 px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-700">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-sm tracking-wide uppercase text-slate-200">Bowling</h3>
        </div>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-sm text-left whitespace-nowrap">
            <thead className="text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-slate-800">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Bowler</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">O</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right hidden sm:table-cell">M</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">R</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right text-emerald-400">W</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-right">ECO</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/50">
              {match.bowlers.map((b, i) => (
                <tr key={i} className="hover:bg-slate-800/30">
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-white">{b.name}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 text-right">{b.overs}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 text-right hidden sm:table-cell">{b.maidens}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 text-right">{b.runs}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 font-black text-emerald-400 text-right">{b.wickets}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 text-right">{b.economy}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TabCommentary({ match }) {
  if (!match.commentary || match.commentary.length === 0) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">No commentary available.</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-lg space-y-0">
      {match.commentary.map((comm, idx) => {
        let evColor = "bg-slate-800 text-slate-300";
        if(comm.event === 'W') evColor = "bg-red-500/20 text-red-500 border border-red-500/30";
        if(comm.event === '4') evColor = "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30";
        if(comm.event === '6') evColor = "bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/30";

        return (
          <div key={comm.id} className="flex gap-4 py-4 border-b border-slate-800/50 last:border-0 hover:bg-slate-800/10 transition-colors px-2 rounded-lg">
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center shrink-0 w-12">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 mb-1">Ov {comm.over}</span>
              <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-black ${evColor}`}>
                {comm.event}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1">
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">{comm.text}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

function TabSquads({ match }) {
  if (!match.squads) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">Playing XI not announced.</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
      {[
        { team: match.team1, squad: match.squads.team1 },
        { team: match.team2, squad: match.squads.team2 }
      ].map((data, idx) => (
        <div key={idx} className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
          <div className={`px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2`}>
             <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
             <h3 className="font-bold text-white">{data.team.fullName} XI</h3>
          </div>
          <ul className="p-2 space-y-1">
            {data.squad.map((player, i) => (
              <li key={i} className="px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-md transition-colors">
                {player}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function SeriesView({ series }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {series.map(s => (
        <div key={s.id} className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between md:items-center gap-4 hover:border-slate-700 transition-colors">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">{s.name}</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400 mt-1">{s.matches} Matches Scheduled</p>
          </div>
          <div className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider inline-flex w-fit
            ${s.status === 'Ongoing' ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400'}`}>
            {s.status}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
